findings.title: update --force leaves the retired orbit-review-external skill + launcher on pre-existing surfaces (no retired-dir cleanup)
findings.recommendation: Fresh init yields the clean 15-skill surface, but an EXISTING project that upgrades and runs update keeps the retired orbit-review-external skill dir + review-external.md launcher loadable (reconciliation only converges declared workflows; the retired dir is no longer a known workflow id, so nothing removes it). Either (A) extend update reconciliation with a retired-artifacts list (e.g. RETIRED_SKILL_DIRS consulted on both update paths, removing known-retired dirs + launchers), or (B) accept and document manual removal as an upgrade note, filing a follow-up issue.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: extend update reconciliation with a retired-artifacts list consulted on both update paths (remove known-retired skill dirs + launcher files)

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: accept the gap; document manual removal as an upgrade note and file a follow-up issue

findings.title: Touchpoints divergence (Category 5, dogfooded): 9 substantive source files in actual-but-not-predicted

The predicted map is FROZEN at apply by design, so the resolution is record-not-edit: acknowledge the divergence on the trail (this finding IS the record) so the archive narrative carries it; no artifact edit.
